entities.name: UniProt Q9SZW7
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana GDSL esterase/lipase At4g30140; 348 aa.
Annotated as secreted and associated with extracellular region, plasma membrane, and pollen tube.
Annotated molecular function: cutinase activity; the sequence contains a Lipase_GDSL (PF00657) domain.
Specific biological process beyond pollen-tube localization is not established by the retrieved annotations.
